title: One visual action at a time
statement: In a film that explains, show one main visual action at a time, with no eye-catching motion behind the explanation.
detail: A draft plan for a reading lesson's opening film turns comments on a reference film into production rules: one main visual action at a time, and no eye-catching background motion during explanations. After comments that characters' clothing and identity drifted between shots it locks cast sheets, scale, wardrobe, props and room geography, and after reports of jitter it asks for every cut to be reviewed in motion (`grade3-reading/artifacts/peter-pan-standing-2026-09-11/video-2026-09-16/PETER-PAN-PART-1-FILM.md`, lines 68, 69 and 81). The plan also keeps every character looking the same from shot to shot.
against: The plan is a draft, pending reconciliation with a reviewed script, and nothing has been made or checked under it (`grade3-reading/artifacts/peter-pan-standing-2026-09-11/video-2026-09-16/PETER-PAN-PART-1-FILM.md`, line 7).
